meta.dedupe: Exact whitespace-normalized sentences; earliest publication; copies = distinct original URLs including keeper.
meta.selection: One record per (sentence, EMD); multiple aliases of one EMD coalesced. Unmapped landmarks retain separate records.
meta.time_selection: Nearest clock to any occurrence of the record place; tie picks first; all clocks retained in time_mentions.
meta.date_selection: Last explicit NN일 before clock wins; otherwise nearest following day; nearest publication month when month absent. Relative day then publication day.
meta.uncertainty: Unqualified 1–12시 without daypart => event_time/t null. No inferred PM from publication time.
caveats: Sentence co-occurrence is not a verified event/action/time/place relation.
first is earliest extracted nominal time, not first actual event or official response.
Unknown landmark locations remain unmapped; no sigungu-to-EMD fanout.
Earliest publication may predate an updated version of the fetched body.
No body is replaced with title, description, or a Naver copy.
Fetches follow input order; a time cap may underrepresent later publications.
meta.hourly_unit: t_hour_start in MINUTES since time_base; floor(t/60)*60. n counts deduplicated EMD records, once regardless of action count.
meta.count_unit: Deduplicated sentence/EMD records per action, including unresolved times.
